tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen (Monad off-white / Monad black).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the duel panel, toasts, the QR panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: HP bar tracks, input wells, disabled and countdown fills. Neutral grey, so it never reads as a purple chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on surface-raised and between list rows. Separation is done with lines, never shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, block number labels, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The one action color: TapButton fill, primary buttons, the player's own HP fill. Never for decoration or rarity.

tokens.name: on-purple
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a purple fill.

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Purple text and links on surface and surface-raised (purple itself is too light for small text).

tokens.name: purple-tint
tokens.usage: Background of chips and selected rows; pairs with purple-ink text.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: SkillButton fill, Epic frame, focus ring, the arena header band. Monad's deep purple in light, its inverse in dark.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on a deep fill.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: The opponent: opponent HP fill and number, damage pop-ups, errors. Text-safe on surface and surface-raised. Never on the player's own things.

tokens.name: berry-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error toasts and the Defeat result banner; pairs with berry text.

tokens.name: element-fire
tokens.usage: Fire element chip text and the Fire image-window border. Content color, used small.

tokens.name: element-water
tokens.usage: Water element chip text and the Water image-window border. Content color, used small.

tokens.name: element-lightning
tokens.usage: Lightning element chip text and the Lightning image-window border. Content color, used small.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common frame (border, not text).

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare frame. Teal, deliberately not purple: purple belongs to the player.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Epic frame.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary frame and the ★ symbol. Gold, deliberately not berry: berry belongs to the opponent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px.

styles.name: display-tap
styles.usage: The word on TapButton and the result headline (Victory / Defeat / Draw).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Nadmon name on the reveal screen, screen titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles, button labels, player names in the duel.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: element and rarity, stat names, small headers.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: HP numbers, damage pop-ups, tx counters on the projector.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Block numbers, latency, tx hashes, stats (ATK 15).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside chips and small buttons; gap between HP bar and its numbers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, gap between duel rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a screen; projector gutters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, HP bars, the card image window. Tailwind: rounded-chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, toasts, the duel panel. Tailwind: rounded-card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: TapButton only. Tailwind: rounded-tap.
